newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Hundreds cut off by rock slide in Austria.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds cut off by rock slide in Austria.

text.p: Several hundred Austrians were cut off from the rest of the country on Sunday after a rock slide in the western province of Salzburg made roads impassable, local rescue services said.

Early on Sunday, falling rocks buried a 200-metre stretch of the main highway leading to the Stubachtal area, just outside the holiday resort of Zell-am-See, 300 kilometres (170 miles) west of Vienna.
Local police said a crisis meeting of rescue services in Zell-am-See would decide how best to clear the road and reach those who were cut off.
